# Deck

## What the cards share

Every card is a Titan Warrior with a spear, and Blood Hunt is its damage: it lunges at a bleeding enemy and consumes its Blood Loss for a burst of physical damage. Bloodlust and Brutality I support it, and Herald of Blood pops the bleeding dead.

## How they differ

Seven of seven are one Blood Hunt loop; they differ in the weapon, the defence and the add-on that clears packs.

## Round 1

- r1-a-1 "Blood Hunt bleed burst" | one lunge spends the bleed you built for a big hit, so rares melt in two presses
- r1-a-2 "Blood Hunt with Rolling Slam clear" | Rolling Slam clears the packs and Blood Hunt finishes the rares, so each button has one job
- r1-b-1 "Blood Hunt on a two-hander" | a two-handed spear's bigger hit makes every lunge count
- r1-b-3 "Blood Hunt armour stacker" | stacked armour shrugs off the hits that kill most melee builds, and Blood Hunt still bursts | under-played (judgment: an armour-stacking shape, rarely paired with a spear lunge)
- r1-c-1 "Blood Hunt with Titan slam notables" | Titan's slam notables make every hit heavier, so the lunge and the slam both grow
- r1-c-2 "Blood Hunt block tank" | block stops most hits outright, so the lunge can go in deeper | under-played (judgment: a block shape few spear builds take)
- r1-c-3 "Blood Hunt rage cycling" | rage builds while you fight and spends itself on bigger lunges
- r1-g-1 "Bleeding Shield Wall" | the bleed burst's lunge behind the block tank's shield | made at the gate (visit 1): from "Blood Hunt bleed burst" and "Blood Hunt block tank"

## Not dealt

- r1-a-3 "Blood Hunt crit lunge" | no lookup confirms "critical hits inflict Blood Loss"
- r1-b-2 "Blood Hunt with a bleed unique" | the same build as "Blood Hunt bleed burst"

## Found, not used

- Herald of Blood as the main clear: no card leads packs with it, since its explosions need a bleeding kill first.
